run_doctest_pointer_adoption: run the doctest suite to verify Boost.Python pointer adoption and reference counting behavior
create_dynamic_instance: create a dynamically allocated A instance and check its content via the content method
test_pointer_adoption_adopt: test pointer adoption by calling B.adopt to transfer ownership of an A instance into B
test_inner_reference_lifetime: test that an A instance stays alive while its inner reference is still held
test_as_a_dynamic_cast: test the as_A function to dynamically cast a Base object to A and verify the result
